title: Get more out of your Aeroplan Elite Status with Marriott Bonvoy
summary: Official partner page and terms. Marriott Titanium and Ambassador Elite members can receive Aeroplan 25K after registering through the partnership site (reviewed, 7-10 business days, not guaranteed). Matched status is described as valid at least 12 months and then expiring under program rules; either program may change or end the offering at any time. Trial status does not qualify.
notes: The page does not say what happens to a matched 25K if the Marriott status is later lost. It is also internally inconsistent on whether the grant is automatic or reviewed.

title: Japan Airlines award sale (October 2026)
summary: Describes redeeming JAL Mileage Bank miles for JAL-operated flights to Japan, including premium cabins; notes a JAL account must be open 60 days before any award can be redeemed and that miles expire strictly. The sale it covered ended October 31, 2026 and excluded business class on North America routes.

title: Marriott & Japan Airlines launch deeper partnership
summary: Reports that the 30,000 or 40,000 FLY ON Points given to Titanium or Ambassador members are enough for Crystal, which equates to oneworld Ruby. Also states the long-standing Marriott to JAL transfer ratio of 3 points per mile, with 5,000 bonus miles per 60,000 points transferred.

title: Register to fast-track your status
summary: Official offer page. Aeroplan 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K and Super Elite members (and premium cardholders) with linked accounts can earn higher World of Hyatt status by completing qualifying nights within 90 days of registering. Registration closes December 31, 2026. Aeroplan elites may use one such offer per calendar year. Hyatt may change or withdraw the offer without notice.
notes: Read from the search-engine excerpt of the official page; the page itself refuses automated fetching (robots). A person should open the page to confirm before relying on it.

title: JMB CRYSTAL
summary: Official JMB Crystal page: Crystal members receive oneworld Ruby services on oneworld alliance airlines.
notes: Read from the search-engine excerpt of the official page.

title: JAL Mileage Bank & Marriott Bonvoy, Status Match Starts
summary: Official programme page (launched July 14, 2026). After linking accounts, Marriott members receive FLY ON Points each year by tier: Titanium 30,000 and Ambassador 40,000, and those two tiers earn Crystal or higher according to accumulated FLY ON Points. Points arrive within about 6 weeks of linking and then each spring. One JAL account links to one Marriott account and the link cannot be changed. Benefits depend on Marriott status on the registration day and, in later years, on the status then held.
notes: Crystal is not described as automatic; the page does not give the threshold, a validity period for status reached this way, or a programme end date.

title: Frequent Flyer Benefits
summary: Official oneworld tier chart: FLY ON Crystal maps to oneworld Ruby, Sapphire to Sapphire, Diamond and JGC Premier to Emerald. JAL Global Club members with Crystal receive Sapphire instead.
notes: Read from the search-engine excerpt of the official page.

title: The Guide to American Express Transfer Partners
summary: Lists Membership Rewards transfer partners: Air Canada Aeroplan at 1:1 and ANA Mileage Club at 1:1, among about two dozen.

title: Hyatt and Air Canada Aeroplan partnership
summary: Reports the 90-day challenge thresholds for Aeroplan elites: Discoverist after 4 nights, Explorist after 10, Globalist after 20 (normally 10, 30 and 60).

title: Marriott Bonvoy & Japan Airlines Launch Partnership
summary: States that Marriott Bonvoy points transfer to JAL Mileage Bank at 3 points per mile, the standard Bonvoy airline ratio.

title: Amex Transfer Partners: Complete List and Best Uses 2026
summary: Lists Aeroplan (1:1, instant) and ANA Mileage Club (1:1, up to about 72 hours); minimum transfer 1,000 points. Says American Express is the only major US card programme that transfers to ANA.

title: Marriott Bonvoy and Japan Airlines Launch Preferred Partnership Program
summary: Reports the tier table: Titanium 30,000 FLY ON Points per year with Crystal or above, Ambassador 40,000 with Crystal or above; one account may be linked to one account and a person may register once.

title: Comparing Star Alliance award charts
summary: Describes ANA business class as bookable with Aeroplan points as a Star Alliance partner award.
notes: Article predates 2026; the prices it quotes are out of date and are deliberately not recorded.

title: Citi to Japan Airlines Mileage Bank transfer bonus
summary: Sets out JAL Mileage Bank award rules: account must be 60 days old before redeeming; awards cannot be changed, only cancelled for a small fee; when saver space is absent JAL reprices business awards far higher; there are limits on whom awards can be booked for.

title: Air Canada Aeroplan award chart changes (June 2026)
summary: Reports a 2026 increase in Aeroplan partner business-class prices between North America and the Pacific zone, naming ANA among the partners on those routings.

title: Hyatt Globalist in just 20 nights instead of 60 - new Air Canada partnership
summary: Independently reports that the Aeroplan-linked challenge yields Globalist after 20 nights rather than the usual 60.
